Source.Name: excalibur-driver
Source.Summary: Casper Excalibur WMI and RGB Keyboard Kernel Driver with DKMS and Rust Core
Source.Description: Linux kernel driver and control utility for Casper Excalibur gaming laptops providing ACPI/WMI power profile management, per-zone RGB keyboard lighting control, fan speed monitoring via hwmon, and DKMS support with a high-performance Rust core.
